text:
alexa: Kicking off the blue->green for service-payments in us-west1 during the 03:00 change window. Target version: v2.4.0. Starting at 5% traffic then gradual ramp. Release notes: https://internal/release/notes/2.4.0 :package:

deploy-bot: [deploy] started rollout: service-payments v2.4.0 -> green pool. Release ID: rel-2026-03-20-0345. Logs: https://ci/build/4321

mike: copying plan here — ramp schedule: 5% -> 20% (5m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (15m). Health checks at each step, auto-fallback on SLO breach.

sara: noted. I'll watch request latency and error rate. If p95 latency > 350ms OR 5xx >= 0.5% for 2m we pause and rollback.

li-chen: router change will be via RouterControl API. Sample command to shift weights:
```
POST /router/control/weights
{
  "service": "service-payments",
  "green_weight": 5
}
```
I have the credentials and will run the commands.

nate: adding a conservative circuit-breaker: if green pods throw >10% 429s or 500s in a minute, router will cut green to 0 automatically per the safety policy.

ops-oncall: FYI — last time we saw a regression with v2.x the cause was an unexpected DB connection pool exhaustion during heavy prefix paths. I've already prepped a DB pool metric watch.

monitoring-bot: [alert-suppression] silence for maintenance window 03:00-03:30 applied.

deploy-bot: step 1 complete: green_weight=5%. 12 green pods warm, 0 active errors reported.

alexa: ack. moving to 20% in 5m if no regressions. @sara @nate please ping here for any anomalies. :thumbsup:

monitoring-bot: Metric update: p95 latency for service-payments increased from 220ms -> 260ms over the last 2m. Error rate 0.03%. Still below thresholds.

li-chen: starting weight change to 20% now. Running RouterControl payload...
```
POST /router/control/weights { green_weight: 20 }
```
deploy-bot: step 2 complete: green_weight=20%.

monitoring-bot: ALERT: 5xx rate spiked to 0.9% over 90s across green pods.

mike: saw it — rolling logs show repeated DB timeouts from green: `timeout acquiring connection`.

alexa: pausing rollout. do not advance to 50%.

sara: agree. moving to mitigation path A (drain green traffic and pin to blue) unless we can quick-fix. Ops, can we pin router now?

li-chen: issuing immediate router pin: set green_weight=0, blue_weight=100. Command:
```
POST /router/control/weights { "green_weight": 0 }
```

monitoring-bot: ACTION: router weights set green=0 by li-chen. Traffic switched back to blue.

ops-oncall: running rollback script to fully revert any db schema flags we toggled in v2.4.0. Command run: `./ops/rollback_service_payments.sh --to v1.9.8`

deploy-bot: rollback executed: service-payments pinned to v1.9.8 in production. Green instances terminated.

nate: we should capture a clear rollback signal in the runbook: condition = 5xx > 0.5% AND DB timeout traces present -> immediate pin and rollback. I'll open a quick PR to the runbook to add the signal and the exact RouterControl endpoint we used.

alexa: good. immediate next steps: 1) Ops to triage DB connection pool cause on v2 (sara + ops-oncall). 2) Postmortem scheduled for 10:00 PT. 3) Do not re-run v2 until pool fix + staging perf pass.

sara: triage note: preliminary root cause looks like connection leak in payment connector under cache-miss path. I'll run a replay in staging.

li-chen: added replay job and a diff of router control logs to the incident doc: https://internal/incidents/2026-03-20-payments-shift.

mike: thanks all. Reaction: :white_check_mark: on safe rollback. We'll follow the rollback checklist and then run a small canary in staging with the fix.

alexa: closing the change window early. Marking release rel-2026-03-20-0345 as rolled back. Will attach release notes and next attempt plan to the incident doc.

monitoring-bot: [note] all alerts cleared after rollback.

deploy-bot: summary: green rollout aborted at 20% due to 5xx spike; RouterControl pin executed and rollback to v1.9.8 completed.

alexa: thanks team. Postmortem and action items in the incident doc. If anyone sees lingering customer impact ping ops-oncall. :pray:
